translations.translatedText: # Friday 22.11.2019 (radio)

The postal strike investigation group has started work. Finland is re-examining asylum decisions. Telia's phone connections have problems. New fire safety recommendations for holiday cottages for rent.
## The postal strike investigation group has started work

![ Seated around the table: former PAM chair Ann Selin (front left), State Secretary Raimo Luoma and former National Conciliator Jukka Ahtela. Seated on the other side of the table were former SAK chair Lauri Ihalainen (left), retired EK labour market director Lasse Laatunen and State Secretary Valtteri Aaltonen (behind the table, on the right).](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11081486)
Open image viewer
The working group started on Friday. Photo: Seppo Samuli / Lehtikuva

The working group that was set up because of the postal strike has started work. The working group began its meeting on Friday morning. The working group is considering how the postal dispute can be resolved.

If the postal dispute continues, many support strikes will begin next week. For example, buses may not run in the Helsinki region on Monday, if the postal dispute continues. Not all ships will be able to go to sea, if the dispute continues. Some of the airport staff will go on strike, if the postal dispute continues.
## Asylum decisions will be reviewed again
![Finnish Immigration Service sign in Helsinki.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10494751)
Open image viewer
Finnish Immigration Service.

Finland is re-examining asylum decisions. The Finnish Immigration Service will re-examine about 500 negative asylum decisions. The decisions are being checked because last week the European Court of Human Rights said that Finland had broken the human rights convention in one decision.

The Finnish Immigration Service is re-examining negative decisions so that Finland does not break the human rights convention again. If shortcomings are found in the decisions, the asylum seeker may make a new application.
## A fault blocked calls and connections on Telia's network
![A woman uses a smartphone.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11070126)
Open image viewer
A widespread fault silenced Telia's phone subscriptions. Photo: Mikael Kokkola / Yle

There was a widespread fault in Telia's mobile network on Friday afternoon. Calls did not always connect to Telia subscriptions, and calls could not be made from Telia subscriptions. Mobile data did not work.
Because mobile data did not work, phones could not be used to buy, for example, a bus ticket. There were also problems making emergency calls on Telia's network.
## New fire safety recommendations for holiday cottages for rent
![Fire inspector checks a smoke alarm.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10034541)
Open image viewer
A fire inspector checks a smoke alarm. Photo: Petri Lassheikki / Yle

The Accident Investigation Board has given new recommendations on the fire safety of holiday cottages for rent. The Accident Investigation Board says that the electrical work in cottages must be done properly, so that they are safe.

Electrical work may only be done by a professional who is licensed to do electrical work. There must be enough escape routes, and they must be clearly marked, so that you can get out of the cottage if a fire breaks out. Cottages must also have more smoke alarms than now.
The Accident Investigation Board has given new fire safety recommendations because people died in a holiday cottage fire at Levi in Kittilä in the spring.
